Gdevelop Achievements

How it gets made · 08-record.md

Pipeline

A GDevelop 5 extension for the public extension store, built in one day (2026-11-16) from idea to pull request. Nothing is hand-edited in GDevelop: Python scripts write the extension and an example game as JSON, GDevelop's own library checks and exports them, and headless Chrome plays the export to prove every feature works before anything is pushed.

  1. IdeaEight extension ideas listed from problems hit while building the Year 3 course games and the jam games; Luqman picked #8, achievements with a toast. The store had no general achievements extension (only Game Jolt and Wortal ones).01-idea.md, Idea Vault
  2. ChoicesFour questions answered before building: one Define action per achievement, a built-in restyleable toast, no built-in achievements screen, ship to the store after trying it.log/2026-11-16.md
  3. Runtime coreThe achievements state, saving and the toast are one JavaScript object kept on the game, shared by every scene. The toast is drawn on its own layer, created at runtime and kept above every other layer.src/core.js
  4. Write the extensionbuild_extension.py turns the core and 30 small functions (actions, conditions, expressions) into the extension file.tools/build_extension.py, extension/Achievements.json
  5. Write the examplebuild_example.py writes a one-scene game whose commented events use every feature, plus a 3D copy used only for testing.tools/build_example.py, example/
  6. Check and exportGDevelop's own library (libGD) loads the project, checks every instruction and expression, and exports a web build. Must print 0 problems and 0 diagnostics.tools/build.sh
  7. Play-testFive scripted runs in headless Chrome: the full example, a phone screen, a missing icon, the cover shot, and a scene rendered in 3D.tools/run_tests.sh, tools/tests/
  8. Help pageGenerated from the same function list, so it cannot drift, and published on GitHub Pages. Reviewed against the Vercel interface guidelines.tools/build_help.py, help/
  9. ShipPublic repo, releases with the example zip, and a pull request to the GDevelop extension store, after running the store's own checks locally.GitHub juslangit/gdevelop-achievements, PR #2360

Tools

GDevelop 5.6.287The engine. The extension is an events-based extension whose functions are short JavaScript events.
libGD.js (vendored)GDevelop's project library in Node: validates every instruction, normalizes the example to the editor's format and exports the web build.
Python 3Writes the extension, the example game, the help page and the five example icons (Pillow).
Playwright + headless ChromePlays the exported game with real key presses and checks the extension's state after each step; takes every screenshot on this page.
GDevelop-extensions checksThe store's npm run build and post-build tests, run locally before every push. They caught one problem: extensions may not call GDevelop's sound tools from JavaScript.
GitHub and GitHub PagesPublic repo, v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 releases, the help page on the gh-pages branch, and the pull request.
Kenney Music Jingles (CC0)The example's unlock sound.

How it is checked (tools/run_tests.sh, after tools/build.sh):

  • Example — unlock in one go, add progress to 10 and to 5, set progress from a timer, Completionist from the unlocked count, the secret achievement hidden then revealed, the icon shown, the sound played, five toasts queued one after another, the save surviving a page reload, reset clearing it, the Malay label and colors, the bottom-right position.
  • Phone — on a 390 px wide screen the toast fits and long text ends in "…".
  • Missing icon — an image that does not exist falls back to the star instead of a blank square.
  • 3D — with a 3D box on the base layer GDevelop switches to its 3D renderer, and the toast still draws on top.
  • Store checks — the store's own build and tests pass on the extension file before it is pushed to the pull request.

What it looks like

Screens

Every game screenshot is the real exported example running in headless Chrome at 1280 x 720 (or a 390 px phone); the editor shots are the GDevelop app on this Mac.

How it works

Nothing happens on screen in the frame an achievement unlocks: the unlock is saved at once, and the next frame's events see it as "just unlocked", wherever the condition sits in the event sheet. The toast queue shows one toast at a time.

flowchart TD
    D[Define achievement: id, title, description, goal] --> P[Add progress / Set progress]
    P --> G{Progress reached the goal?}
    G -- no --> S1[Save progress]
    G -- yes --> U[Unlock]
    U2[Unlock achievement] --> U
    U --> S2[Save, unlocked]
    U --> J[Pending list]
    U --> Q[Toast queue]
    J -- next frame, before events --> JU[Achievement was just unlocked: true for that frame]
    Q -- after events, one at a time --> T[Toast slides in on its own top layer]
    T --> TA[A toast just appeared: true next frame, plays the sound]

The toast

The toast needs no object in the scene. It takes the achievement's icon if it has one, otherwise a star, and fits its text to the screen.

In GDevelop

The example's event sheet as a game maker sees it: every action reads as a sentence, and the comments explain each feature.

Help page

juslangit.github.io/gdevelop-achievements, the extension's help link. The reference tables are generated from the extension itself.

The idea

Idea #8 of the GDevelop extension list made 2026-11-16 (Idea Vault 874). The store has no general achievements extension (only Game Jolt and Wortal ones), and every game wants them.

Luqman's choices (2026-11-16): one "Define achievement" action per achievement; a built-in restyleable toast; no built-in achievements screen (expressions only, the example shows one); ship to the store via PR after he tries it.

04-methods.md · 0 sections

Methods

  • Extension free-function instructions take a hidden first AND last parameter: ["", ...params, ""].
  • GDevelop "key just pressed" misses Playwright press; hold keys ~60 ms in tests.
  • Tools copied from gdevelop-year3 tap-dash (gdenv/loader/build_html5/play.js + vendored libGD); node_modules is node_modules.nosync + symlink so iCloud doesn't sync it.
  • Opening in GDevelop: open -a "GDevelop 5" --args "<path>/Achievements Example.json" (GDevelop must be closed).
  • Store submission: fork GDevelopApp/GDevelop-extensions, file in extensions/community/, run npm install && npm run build and npm run check-post-build locally, PR with their template. They want the example zip attached; Luqman's Chrome isn't signed in to GitHub, so it went on our repo's release and was linked in a PR comment.
  • Resource parameters (imageResource/audioResource) hold the bare resource name in instruction JSON, never a quoted "text".
  • Store checker forbids some gdjs.* in JS (e.g. gdjs.evtTools.sound): run npm run build in the store clone before pushing.
  • Headless 3D: a scene with GDevelop's "Play a sound" action in its events logs one WebGL warning (uniformMatrix3fv) in swiftshader even if it never runs — not from the extension (bisected 2026-11-16).
  • Tests: tools/build.sh then tools/run_tests.sh (example, phone, bad_icon, hero, three_d).
  • Republish help: python3 tools/build_help.py, commit, git branch -D gh-pages; git subtree split --prefix help -b gh-pages; git push -f origin gh-pages.

06-decisions.md · 0 sections

Decisions

DateDecisionWhy
2026-11-16Runtime core in JavaScript (src/core.js), thin JS events per functionToast drawing and storage are far simpler and safer in JS than in events; store accepts JS extensions
2026-11-16Toast drawn on its own runtime layer __AchievementsToast, kept lastIn games with a 3D renderer GDevelop renders each layer separately, so a child of the scene container would never show
2026-11-16Save in localStorage key GDJS_Achievements_<game name>Works in web/desktop/mobile; game name avoids clashes on shared origins like gd.games
2026-11-16"Just unlocked" is true for the whole next frame (pending → just in onScenePreEvents)Works wherever the condition sits in the event sheet, exactly once
2026-11-16PIXI v7/v8 feature-detectedSafe across GDevelop versions
2026-11-16Toast sound = condition "A toast just appeared" + GDevelop's Play a sound, not a sound actionStore checker forbids gdjs.evtTools.sound in extension JS (needs reviewer exception); don't route around it
2026-11-16Don't convert actions to events pre-emptivelyAll actions share the JS state the toast and saving need; splitting it would make the code worse. Only if a reviewer asks
2026-11-16Help page generated from FUNCTIONS, published from gh-pages (subtree of help/)Can't drift from the extension; keeps the local project record (docs/) off the web
